dataset: sklearn.datasets.load_breast_cancer (569x30); positive class y=1 is malignant (y = 1 - sklearn target)

selection_rule.ensemble_candidate: RF, unless HGB mean macro F1 exceeds RF mean by more than RF fold std
selection_rule.choose_ensemble_if: (a: mean F1 gain > tree fold std) OR (b: prediction disagreement >= 3x lower AND mean F1 not lower), AND (c: predict 1000 < 1 s and pickle < 50 MB)

cv_evidence.outer_cv: RepeatedStratifiedKFold(5 x 4, random_state=42), identical folds for all models

rationale: Random Forest chosen by the pre-registered rule before opening the test set: delta macro F1 (ensemble - tree) = +0.040 vs tree fold std 0.033; prediction disagreement ratio tree/ensemble = 3.8x; engineering cost acceptable.
